item.title: Donut Solid-State Battery Hits 100kW in Verge Pack Test
item.description: Donut’s stepped out of the lab. After a run of cell-level tests with VTT, the latest video finally shows what everyone’s been waiting for, the battery in an actual bike. A Verge TS Pro test mule, plugged into a public fast charger, running Donut’s solid-state pack in the real world. No lab coats this time. Just a bike, a cable, and a stopwatch.

item.title: Energica is Back, Again | July 2026 Deliveries Planned
item.description: The much-loved Italian outfit, and builders of some of the sharpest, track-capable electric machines to ever hit public roads, reckon they’re back on form after yet another wobble behind the scenes. And they’re not being subtle about it.

item.title: LiveWire ONE UK Price Drop to £12,990
item.description: LiveWire has cut the price of the ONE across Europe, with fresh pricing now appearing in the UK, Germany and Switzerland. The bike now starts at £12,990 in the UK, down from £18,290, the kind of move that shifts it out of halo-bike money and into a much more realistic conversation.

item.title: FTN Motion Streetdog XR launched | More speed, more stance

item.title: Benzina Zero UK Launch: MicroVolt Distribution Deal | Buck City Biker
item.description: Benzina Zero has landed in the UK through distributor MicroVolt, giving its utility bikes a clearer route into the British market.

item.title: Donut Damaged-Cell Safety Test Shows No Thermal Runaway
item.description: The latest instalment in the Donut saga is here, and this one builds on the VTT programme we’ve been tracking from the start. Up to now, the focus has been on charging speed, thermal behaviour and real-world pack performance. This latest test shifts the spotlight onto safety, specifically, how the cell behaves after it’s already been damaged.

item.title: Positive Motorcycles EGERA: Italian Electric Motorcycle Moves Closer to Market
item.description: Positive Motorcycles is back on the radar, and this time the story is less about the EGERA itself and more about whether the Italian outfit can get riders on the road. The Lake Como startup says it is entering a pre-seed round after five years of self-funded R&D, with a validated prototype, identified distributors, secured suppliers and road testing up to 175 km/h (108 mph) already under its belt.

item.title: Honda WN7 Wins iF Design Award 2026
item.description: Honda’s WN7 has picked up a Gold at the iF Design Award 2026, and whether you care about trophies or not, it says something about how this bike’s landing. Let’s be honest, most design awards don’t move the needle for riders. But this one’s worth a second look, mainly because Honda didn’t win by going weird.

item.title: Electric Motion EP01 Enduro Prototype Signals Move Beyond Trials
item.description: French brand Electric Motion has teased the EP01, an early-stage enduro prototype that signals a move out of the trials section and into a different kind of off-road territory.

item.title: Electric Motorcycle Market Growth Splits: Asia Leads, West Lags
item.description: A new industry report from Motorcycle Global, a research/consultancy firm, shows the electric motorcycle market still growing, but the early surge has been replaced with something more measured.
